license_required.quote: An ambulance service, ambulance, nontransporting emergency medical service, emergency medical services person, emergency medical services ambulance operator, emergency medical dispatch center or emergency medical dispatcher may not operate or practice unless duly licensed by the Emergency Medical Services' Board pursuant to this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: may not operate or practice unless duly licensed by the Emergency Medical Services' Board pursuant to this chapter

name.quote: The Emergency Medical Services' Board, as established by Title 5, section 12004‑A, subsection 15, is responsible for the emergency medical services program.

type.quote: The Emergency Medical Services' Board, as established by Title 5, section 12004‑A, subsection 15, is responsible for the emergency medical services program.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of Public Safety.

degree_required.value: Successfully completed training specified in rules adopted by the board
degree_required.quote: The person must have completed successfully the training specified in rules adopted by the board pursuant to the Maine Administrative Procedure Act.

degree_level.quote: The person must have completed successfully the training specified in rules adopted by the board pursuant to the Maine Administrative Procedure Act.

credential_pegged.quote: The person must have completed successfully the training specified in rules adopted by the board pursuant to the Maine Administrative Procedure Act.

required.quote: The person must have completed successfully the training specified in rules adopted by the board pursuant to the Maine Administrative Procedure Act.

experience_source.quote: The person must have completed successfully the training specified in rules adopted by the board pursuant to the Maine Administrative Procedure Act.

exams.name: Board-approved cognitive test for basic emergency medical treatment
exams.notes: Also requires a board-approved assessment of emergency medical treatment skills.
exams.quote: The person must have successfully completed a board-approved cognitive test for basic emergency medical treatment and a board-approved assessment of emergency medical treatment skills.

required.quote: The person must have satisfactorily completed relicensure training as defined in the rules

available.quote: Ambulance services and ambulances licensed in another state or province, provided that they do not have a base of operation in Maine and do not routinely pick up patients from the scene of their illness or injury in Maine and do not routinely carry patients between points both of which are in Maine

exists.quote: The board, by majority vote and in consultation with the Commissioner of Public Safety or the commissioner's designee, shall appoint the Emergency Medical Services Licensing Board.

name.quote: "Licensing board" means the Emergency Medical Services Licensing Board appointed by the board pursuant to section 84, subsection 1, paragraph H.

authority.value: The board shall delegate authority to the licensing board to grant licenses pursuant to this chapter.
authority.quote: The board shall delegate authority to the licensing board to grant licenses pursuant to this chapter.

regulatory_model.quote: An ambulance service, ambulance, nontransporting emergency medical service, emergency medical services person, emergency medical services ambulance operator, emergency medical dispatch center or emergency medical dispatcher may not operate or practice unless duly licensed by the Emergency Medical Services' Board pursuant to this chapter

credential_type.quote: "License" means a full, temporary, provisional or conditional license issued by the board under this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: may not operate or practice unless duly licensed by the Emergency Medical Services' Board pursuant to this chapter

title_protection.quote: may not operate or practice unless duly licensed by the Emergency Medical Services' Board pursuant to this chapter

scope_protection.quote: An ambulance service, ambulance, nontransporting emergency medical service, emergency medical services person, emergency medical services ambulance operator, emergency medical dispatch center or emergency medical dispatcher may not operate or practice unless duly licensed by the Emergency Medical Services' Board pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license or in connection with service rendered within the scope of the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license under this chapter or in connection with service rendered within the scope of the license issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any drug, narcotic or substance that is illegal or that impairs ability to provide EMS
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any drug, narcotic or substance that is illegal under state or federal law, or to the extent that the licensee's ability to provide emergency medical services or emergency medical dispatch services would be impaired

disciplinary_grounds.description: Declaration or claim of legal incompetence that has not been legally terminated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A declaration of or claim pertaining to the licensee of legal incompetence that has not been legally terminated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any condition or impairment within preceding 3 years, including substance use disorder or mental/emotional/nervous disorder, that affects ability to provide EMS
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any condition or impairment within the preceding 3 years, including, but not limited to, substance use disorder or a mental, emotional or nervous disorder or condition, that in any way affects, or if untreated could impair, the licensee's ability to provide emergency medical services or emergency medical dispatch services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of emergency care by a person not duly licensed who purports to be so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of emergency care by a person not duly licensed under this chapter who purports to be so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent professional practice as evidenced by inability to respond appropriately or apply required skills
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetent professional practice as evidenced by: (1) Demonstrated inability to respond appropriately to a client, patient or the general public; or (2) Inability to apply principles, skills or knowledge necessary to successfully carry out the practice for which the licensee is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any reasonable standard of professional behavior, conduct or practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any reasonable standard of professional behavior, conduct or practice that has been established in the practice for which the licensee is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of crime involving dishonesty, directly related to practice, incarcerable for one year or more, or sexual offense crime
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to the limitations of Title 5, chapter 341, conviction of a crime that involves dishonesty or false statement, conviction of a crime that relates directly to the practice for which the licensee is licensed, conviction of a crime for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed or conviction of a crime defined in Title 17‑A, chapter 11, 12 or 45

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of this chapter or any rule adopted by the board or the licensing board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of this chapter or any rule adopted by the board or the licensing board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Other purposes as specified by rules or law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For other purposes as specified by rules or law.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Every ambulance service and nontransporting emergency medical service must be licensed, operate in accordance with the rules adopted and protocols developed for services under this chapter and carry the equipment called for in those rules.

definition_quote.value: "Emergency medical treatment" means those skills, techniques and judgments, as defined by the board, which are directed to maintaining, improving or preventing the deterioration of the medical condition of the patient and which are appropriate to be delivered by trained persons at the scene of a patient's illness or injury outside the hospital and during transportation to the hospital.
definition_quote.quote: "Emergency medical treatment" means those skills, techniques and judgments, as defined by the board, which are directed to maintaining, improving or preventing the deterioration of the medical condition of the patient and which are appropriate to be delivered by trained persons at the scene of a patient's illness or injury outside the hospital and during transportation to the hospital.

methods_authorized.quote: "Basic emergency medical services person" means a person licensed to perform basic emergency medical treatment. ... "Advanced emergency medical person" means an emergency medical services person licensed to perform advanced emergency medical treatment.

drug_authority.value: EMS persons must administer and dispense naloxone hydrochloride or another opioid overdose-reversing medication in compliance with protocols and training developed in accordance with this chapter.
drug_authority.quote: An emergency medical services person licensed under this chapter shall administer and dispense naloxone hydrochloride or another opioid overdose-reversing medication in compliance with protocols and training developed in accordance with this chapter.

certification_levels.quote: "Basic emergency medical services person" means a person licensed to perform basic emergency medical treatment. ... "Advanced emergency medical person" means an emergency medical services person licensed to perform advanced emergency medical treatment.

community_paramedicine_authorized.quote: The board may establish community paramedicine services. As used in this subsection, "community paramedicine" means the practice by an emergency medical services provider primarily in an out-of-hospital setting of providing episodic patient evaluation, advice and treatment directed at preventing or improving a particular medical condition, within the scope of practice of the emergency medical services provider as specifically requested or directed by a physician.

medical_director_required.quote: an emergency medical services provider, including, but not limited to, an ambulance service or nontransporting emergency medical service, that conducts community paramedicine services shall work with an identified primary care medical director, have an emergency medical services medical director

standing_orders_authorized.quote: the board may provide, by rule, which advanced skills, techniques and judgments may be supervised by a physician by means of standing orders, by voice radio and by other means.

protocol_approval_process.value: The Medical Direction and Practices Board is responsible for creation, adoption and maintenance of Maine Emergency Medical Services protocols pursuant to section 88‑B.
protocol_approval_process.quote: The Medical Direction and Practices Board is responsible for creation, adoption and maintenance of Maine Emergency Medical Services protocols pursuant to section 88‑B.

ambulance_service_license_required.quote: Every ambulance service and nontransporting emergency medical service must be licensed, operate in accordance with the rules adopted and protocols developed for services under this chapter

ambulance_vehicle_inspection_required.quote: Each ambulance must be licensed pursuant to this chapter. It must also meet the design criteria and must be equipped as specified in rules adopted under this chapter.

minimum_staffing_requirements.value: Whenever an ambulance transports a patient from the scene of an emergency, the patient must be cared for by a physician, by a flight nurse or by a person licensed under this chapter to provide emergency medical care.
minimum_staffing_requirements.quote: Whenever an ambulance transports a patient from the scene of an emergency, the patient must be cared for by a physician, by a flight nurse or by a person licensed under this chapter to provide emergency medical care.

regional_ems_council_structure.quote: "Regional council" means a business entity recognized by the board that represents a geographical area of the State, as designated by the board, with respect to matters subject to this chapter.

statewide_ems_medical_director_position.quote: "Statewide emergency medical services' medical director" means a licensed physician appointed by the board.

trauma_system_designation.quote: "Trauma care system" means a subsystem within the emergency medical services system, consisting of an organized arrangement of personnel, equipment and facilities, designed to manage the treatment of the trauma patient.

service_zone_or_primary_service_area_sys.quote: "Regions" means those geographical areas of the State designated by the board to be represented by a regional council.

military_veteran_licensure_pathway.quote: If a person holds a valid license issued by an occupational or professional licensing board established in Title 5, section 12004‑A, at the time of initial enlistment in the United States Armed Forces and the license lapses during the licensee's initial enlistment, that person may obtain a temporary license

criminal_background_check_required.quote: The licensing board shall obtain criminal history record information containing a record of public criminal history record information as defined in Title 16, section 703, subsection 9 for an applicant seeking licensure under this subsection.

naloxone_administration_authorized.quote: An emergency medical services person licensed under this chapter shall administer and dispense naloxone hydrochloride or another opioid overdose-reversing medication in compliance with protocols and training developed in accordance with this chapter.

patient_transport_refusal_rules.quote: A patient is not required to accept treatment to which the patient does not consent.

treatment_of_police_dogs_authorized.quote: an emergency medical services person licensed under this chapter may provide emergency medical treatment to a law enforcement dog, as defined in Title 14, section 164‑B, subsection 1, paragraph B, or to a search and rescue dog

ems_data_collection_required.quote: The board shall establish by rule a program for collecting and reporting cost and performance metrics related to emergency medical treatment services, including ambulance services.

quality_assurance_program_required.quote: The board shall establish and maintain a statewide quality assurance and improvement committee and shall adopt rules, which are routine technical rules pursuant to Title 5, chapter 375, subchapter II‑A, regarding the requirements and authority of the statewide quality assurance and improvement committee.

ems_instructor_certification.quote: The board shall adopt rules, which are routine technical rules pursuant to Title 5, chapter 375, subchapter 2‑A, regarding the requirements for certification and licensing of persons engaged in emergency medical services education and training.

emergency_medical_dispatcher_certificati.quote: A person may not provide emergency medical dispatch services unless the person is licensed by the board as an emergency medical dispatcher in accordance with this section.

civil_immunity_for_good_faith_care.quote: A physician functioning within the medical control system established by the regional medical director and practicing in a hospital to or from which patients are transported under section 86 or health care practitioner under such a physician's supervision who gives oral or written instructions to a basic emergency medical services person or an advanced emergency medical person for the provision of emergency medical treatment outside the hospital is not civilly liable for negligence as a result of issuing the instructions, if the instructions were in accordance with the protocol for the patient's reported condition.

physician_online_medical_control_immunit.quote: A physician functioning within the medical control system established by the regional medical director and practicing in a hospital to or from which patients are transported under section 86 or health care practitioner under such a physician's supervision who gives oral or written instructions to a basic emergency medical services person or an advanced emergency medical person for the provision of emergency medical treatment outside the hospital is not civilly liable for negligence as a result of issuing the instructions

ems_personnel_death_benefit.quote: in a case in which the director determines under rules adopted pursuant to this section that an emergency medical services person has died while in the line of duty ... the State shall pay a benefit of $100,000.
